verdicts.reason: A is the better resize. Its headline is large and clearly the main message, and the copy reads top to bottom properly. Its flaws: the SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to an illegible speck, and the NEW FLAVOR badge has been moved below the can and drawn almost as large as the CTA, so the two compete. The CTA also nearly touches the canvas edges. In B, the NEW FLAVOR badge is the biggest element at the top and outranks the headline. The headline is undersized and breaks awkwardly as 'Chase the / Light'. The CTA text is tiny and hard to read, and the bottom quarter of the canvas is empty.
